name: Rinasclta Q-AERO GR
why_interesting: A current 50C direct frameset with T47, UDH, per-size painted weights and a manufacturer-described aero/Wind Eye shell.
missing: Current mainland-CNY selected-option price and stock

facts.frame: T800/T1000-claimed carbon with manufacturer Q-AERO/Wind Eye marketing
facts.frame_material: Toray T800 + T1000 carbon fiber; no exact ply schedule or resin system is published
facts.frame_construction: Aerodynamic gravel frame with Wind Eye seatstay opening, 1.5-inch straight head tube, T47 86.5 mm shell, UDH and 27.2 mm round seatpost
facts.stiffness_evidence: The manufacturer describes efficient power transfer, drivetrain stability and front-end stiffness, but publishes no exact-model deflection protocol or independent stiffness result
facts.frame_weight_basis: Size 52/S, UD black painted, ±20 g; official per-size range is 1,180–1,260 g
facts.warranty: Two-year manufacturer-direct frame warranty against manufacturing defects; proof of purchase and product/order identification required

price_status: Current exact official-store US$639 reference converted to CNY; no attributable mainland selected checkout
source_note: Official painted frame weights are 1,180/1,200/1,220/1,240/1,260 g for sizes 49/52/54/56/58, each ±20 g. The package includes frame, fork, seatpost, headset, clamp, thru axles and hanger. Manufacturer aero language is retained as marketing evidence, not an independent drag result.

observed_price.price_basis: Current exact Q-AERO GR sale amount converted at the dated ECB reference cross-rate
observed_price.conditions: Reference only; selected size, finish, shipping, tax, duties, actual FX, stock and mainland checkout are unverified
